name: Austria: Part II package and CTIS upload check
applies_to: the Austria package as a whole (plan-level checklist step)

items.check: K1 recruitment and informed-consent procedure present, on the current EU v2.0 template, with a section for every population pathway in the plan.
K2 recruitment material present for every recruitment tool used before the participation decision.

Standard adult German PIS and ICF present, and one L1 set per population in population_sets whose trigger is true; every special population has the separate participant document required for its pathway (legal representative, post-hoc, parents and age-appropriate documents from 8, genetics, future use, pregnancy).
L2 other subject information material present.

For every Austrian site: M1 CV (dated, not older than one year), M2 declaration of interest, GCP training evidence, and N1 on the national Austrian Trial Site Suitability Form signed by the correct local signatory.

Complete insurance evidence: O1 insurance confirmation and O2 policy and terms and conditions, covering participant insurance, extended investigator liability and criminal legal-protection insurance; insured participant number reconciled with the higher Austrian total in the site forms or CTIS; cover over the full planned duration.
P1 compensation and financial-arrangements statement present.
R1 GDPR statement including the Austrian national data-protection confirmation.
S1 biological-samples form, consistent with the protocol, participant information and any secondary-use document.
Outside Part II: German protocol synopsis planned with Part I; national contact and billing address uploaded in the CTIS 'Proof of Payment of Fee' area.
All participant-facing K and L materials are German.
German full and public titles entered in CTIS match the title on the ICF and the insurance materials.
Certified translations present for any planned non-German-speaking participant population.
Administrative documents in the language set in requirements.json (English for a multinational dossier).

No participant signatures in uploaded K and L documents; no signature required on M1/M2 at submission; N1 signed before upload with wet-ink, advanced or qualified electronic signature, never a pasted scan.
Compensation amounts, methods and conditions identical in P1 and every participant document.
Insurer, policy number, contact and obligations identical in O1/O2 and every participant document; national insurance contact point present.
Sample types, storage, transfers and retention identical in S1, the protocol and the participant documents.
Data flows, recipients, third-country transfers and retention identical in R1, the participant documents and the protocol.
Consent pathways in K1 match the L1 sets in the package.
Planned participant numbers in the N1 forms, CTIS Member State Concerned data and the insurance cover agree.

Documents adapted from the reference package contain all Austrian national additions (verbatim insurance and data-protection passages, contacts, population documents) and no leftovers from the reference country.
items.applies_when: Austria is not the reference package

items.check: Correct B-S section prefix and CTIS placeholder for each document.
Unique, self-explanatory title of at most 100 characters: <section code>_<document type>_<subtype>_<country>_<language>_<special attribute>, with only the fields that distinguish the document.
Version and date entered in CTIS metadata, not in the title.
Personal names only where disclosure permits (principal investigator in M1/M2).
Clean, tracked-change, redacted or public and split-file variants clearly distinguished.
Uploaded filename base contains none of ( ) / , . ; | [ ] (the period before the extension is fine).
Site contact list, where used, marked 'not for publication' in CTIS.
Article 11 workaround: every mandatory Part II placeholder holds the official placeholder PDF titled Part_II_placeholder_document_Article_11_workaround.
items.applies_when: Austria receives Part I only under Article 11

items.check: For each document, publication status checked against the current Annex I publication tables (revised CTIS transparency rules; ACT EU guidance v2.2, 30 April 2026).
Publishable documents: personal data and CCI identified separately; public version redacts only qualifying material; signatures never disclosed.
Insurance documents for assessment are unredacted except information irrelevant to the insurance assessment, such as a clearly identified premium.
No personal data or CCI in public structured fields.
No drafting instruction remains in any document (see content/conventions/template-instructions.md).
Every document approved by the owner in TrialAgents, or the user has explicitly chosen to export unapproved versions.
